records.name: Test Mission 12
records.description: Boss only, above con

records.name: Test Mission 11
records.description: Boss, minion, hazard, above con.

records.name: Test Mission 13
records.description: Boss, minion, hazard, below con.

records.name: Unwelcome Visitors
records.description: At night, our camps are beset with the howls and cries of the local wildlife, namely the prowlers that come out of the woods to seek easy prey.

records.name: Let Sleeping Bears...
records.description: A nearby cave has been taken over by a massive, slumbering bear. Clear out the cave, so we can rest easier ourselves.

records.name: From Her Tower
records.description: The Garden of Elune has fallen to terrifying shadow-creatures, including a night elf sorceress now known only as The Oracle.

records.name: Rally the Nightwatchers
records.description: For centuries, the Nightwatchers kept Nar'thalas safe and beautiful. Now, it's fallen to the naga, and even their own spirits turn against them.

records.name: Weary Traveler
records.description: It's one thing to have to camp in the middle of the woods, and it's another to wake full of tiny darts and surrounded by evil sprites.

records.name: To Sleep, To Scream
records.description: Our sentries are terrified. At night, some great creature screeches and howls at them from the darkness. Seek out the terror that flaps in the night.

records.name: Scouting Faronaar
records.description: Faronaar is one of the Legion's most well-protected bastions in Azsuna. If we can take out some of their powerful demons, we will have the advantage.

records.name: Diggin' Song
records.description: The drogbar have burrowed their way out of the hills of Suramar, and are causing structural instability to the buildings in the area. We should root them out.

records.name: Guarding the Moon
records.description: Outside the Moon Guard Stronghold, a siegemaster is blocking the way with a massive arcane siege weapon.

records.name: Omniara Needs Help
records.description: The Hall of the Guardian is established, but we are going to need more help. Archmage Omniara, a renowned Elemental Summoner, was just attacked!

records.name: Plagued Bears
records.description: Highmountain has a bear problem. Not just any bears, but bears cursed and corrupted by the harpies. We should cull them and end their suffering.

records.name: Border Reinforcements
records.description: The Highmountain tauren have called for reinforcements to protect Thunder Totem from drogbar invaders. We should bolster their borders.

records.name: In A Time of Peril
records.description: At the worst possible time, we have a worgen hunter who's gone mad. He's setting out traps for our allies. Hunt the hunter.

records.name: Bitterbrine Treasure
records.description: Along the coast of Azsuna, the Britterbrine raiders have collected and hoarded vast amounts of loot. We should see if we can claim any.

records.name: Tip the Scales
records.description: The Hatecoil hold an ace up their sleeves - if naga had sleeves. They have a massive creature, ready to summon at any moment. Destroy Golza.

records.name: The Rocks Below
records.description: The vrykul use runestones to summon powerful elementals, including Boulderfall, the Eroded, who can block the flow of rivers vital to the life of the valley.

records.name: Tempestuous Waters
records.description: In the Drowned Gardens of Azsuna, the Hatecoil naga have disturbed the souls of the Nightwatchers. Seek out and destroy their Stormbringer sorceress.

records.name: The Dalaran Sewers
records.description: Dalaran is no stranger to attack, but sometimes the threat comes from within. A mage's experimental creature has escaped into the sewers.

records.name: Reef Lord
records.description: Off the coast of Suramar, the naga have set up a stronghold. Below, Reef Lord Raj'his gathers a powerful army of ocean-dwellers.

records.name: Slippery When Wet
records.description: The lion seals of Azsuna are taking up much of the viable shoreline and driving everyone away. Remove Ravyn-Drath, and the others will follow.

records.name: The Pale Predator
records.description: Some beasts don't wait for the cover of darkness to attack, and Abesha, a pale beast, has been stalking our allies in broad daylight. Dispose of the beast.

records.name: Gorgamesh Falls
records.description: An attack squad of demons has emerged from Legion Camp: Chaos, and now threatens our allies in Azsuna. Seek out Lord Gorgamesh and his wyrmtongues.

records.name: Lilith and her Nightborne
records.description: Even other nightborne are afraid of Lilith the Terrible, who stalks the night with her dreaded Infiltrators. Face all fears, and dispose of Lilith.

records.name: The Eighth Shield
records.description: Defending the borders of Suramar, Guardian Thor'el is sworn to attack anyone that approaches the city. Strike at the guardian to help clear a path.

records.name: Her Foulness
records.description: The evil magic of the Nightmare has been seeping into the rivers of Val'sharah, and altered the aquatic life to a terrible degree.

records.name: The Nameless King
records.description: The vrykul's long-dead ancestors rise from their graves, threatening our allies. Face the Nameless King, and put him back to rest.

records.name: The Missing Vessel: Highmountain
records.description: Harpies love anything shiny, and the skywitches of Highmountain have stolen a piece of the vessel. Take it back, so we can set a trap for Hakkar.

records.name: The Missing Vessel: Stormheim
records.description: A fragment of the vessel has fallen into the hands of Aughild the Bitter, a failed valkyra aspirant. Recover it from her, so we can set a trap for Hakkar.

records.name: Dark Storms
records.description: Dark storms still gather above the Tomb of Sargeras, where the Legion army has gathered. Let us send our champions to the Broken Shore to scout the area and look for survivors.

records.name: Wrath and Justice
records.description: Now that we have some recruits, we should deploy them in the field. A wrathguard, Valitos, leads a demon attack on Hearthglen. Let us send our champions to aid the citizens there.

records.name: Hammer Falls
records.description: The vrykul of Stormheim compete fiercely to win the favor of the Valkyra, and Isel the Hammer smiths their shields. We should remove her.

records.name: The Lone Walker
records.description: Wandering the remains of a ruined tower in Suramar, the nightborne Cadraeus threatens the roads and any travelers in the area.

records.name: Mrlglmrmgm
records.description: Crab Rider Grmlrml seems to have found a new way of getting around. If it takes hold, we could be looking at an invasion of crab-riding murlocs.

records.name: Eternal Mages
records.description: In the Temple of a Thousand Lights, ancient mages still linger in the form of spirits and banshees. Destroy Arcanist Thinwhisp and her Ancient Flamecallers.

records.name: The Screeching Forest
records.description: The Nightmare has transformed once-beautiful creatures into twisted visions. Wraithtalon, once a mighty hippogryph, now preys upon our allies.

records.name: Shipwreck Cove
records.description: The murlocs of Shipwreck Cove have caused more than their fair share of wrecks. Dispose of their Grand Admiral, and the waterways should be safer.

records.name: Archmage Vargoth's Travels: Ruins of Nar'thalas
records.description: The Nar'thalas Academy was once a place of great learning. Although it is now in ruins, we know Archmage Vargoth visited it recently.

records.name: Archmage Vargoth's Travels: The Scholars of Tel'anor
records.description: The magical tome we found most likely came from Tel'anor. We may be able to learn more of Archmage Vargoth's travels there if you send a champion.

records.name: Archmage Vargoth's Travels: The Forests of Ashenvale
records.description: The crystal ball we found in Archmage Vargoth's study was used by Grommash Hellscream. We should send a Champion to investigate its former location in Ashenvale.

records.name: Archmage Vargoth's Travels: Best Friends Forever
records.description: Zooti Fizzlefury is Archmage Vargoth's closest friend and confidant. Send a champion to Archmage Khadgar's tower in Talador to see if Zooti is still there.

records.name: Oculus Preparations: A Nightmarish Situation
records.description: Verdisa of the green dragonflight has asked for our help in capturing roving satyr warbands in Val'sharah. Help take down their foes!

records.name: Oculus Preparations: Communication Disruption
records.description: Belgaristrasz of the red dragonflight has contacted us with a plan to retake the Oculus. He needs as many Legion communication devices as can be found.

records.name: Oculus Preparations: Ley Them Down
records.description: We will need to boost our power if we are to break through the wards surrounding the Oculus. The Ley Ruins of Zarkhenar are continually spilling out ley energy.

records.name: Oculus Preparations: Eternos
records.description: Eternos of the Bronze Dragonflight reports a Legion invasion near the Bronze Dragonshrine in Dragonblight. He requests our aid!

records.name: Oculus Preparations: On The Offensive
records.description: Verdisa, Belgaristrasz, and Eternos are reluctant to return to the Oculus themselves. However, some of their strongest drakes will aid us if we clear the way.

records.name: The Highlord's Command: Nemesis
records.description: A small demon force has been located in eastern Azsuna, and rumors are that they report directly to Balnazzar. Send our champions to confront them.

records.name: The Highlord's Command: Holy Allies
records.description: An order of priests from the Conclave have been spotted combing the landing site of the Broken Shore, searching for survivors amidst dangerous demons.

records.name: The Highlord's Command: Legion Defense
records.description: The furbolgs of Val'sharah appear to have come under a demonic influence. We must investigate at once.

records.name: The Highlord's Command: Procuring Supplies
records.description: We've made contact with a tribe of Highmountain tauren. They have an excess supply of furs and leather, but a demon incursion stands in the way.

records.name: Procuring Supplies
records.description: A small demon force has been located in eastern Aszuna, and rumors are that they report directly to Balnazzar. Send our champions to confront them, and extract any information we can about the dreadlord's location.

records.name: Artifact: Skull of the Man'ari
records.description: The sorcerer Thal'kiel was one of the first Eredar who learned the techniques of summoning and controlling demons. His skull would make a powerful weapon if we can locate it.

records.name: Artifact: Deadwind Harvester
records.description: Wielded by Sataiel, the first necrolyte, the Deadwind Harvester earned its name by stripping the life from the lands known as Deadwind pass. After centuries locked away, Ulthalesh has been discovered in the posession of the Dark Riders - we must track them down.

records.name: One Who's Worthy
records.description: We need to find a warlock who excels at summoning greater demons. Scout the hills of Highmountain, keeping an eye out for anyone with potential.

records.name: One Who's Worthy
records.description: We need to find a warlock who excels at summoning greater demons. Scout within Azsuna, keeping an eye out for anyone with potential.

records.name: One Who's Worthy
records.description: We need to find a warlock who excels at summoning greater demons. Scout within Val'sharah, keeping an eye out for anyone with potential.

records.name: One Who's Worthy
records.description: We need to find a warlock who excels at summoning greater demons. Scout within Stormheim, keeping an eye out for anyone with potential.

records.name: Thunderaan's Enemies: Mistius
records.description: A group of former Lieutenants of Al'Akir have opposed the rule of the new Windlord. One of them, Mistius, has been particularly violent against the Earthen Ring.

records.name: Thunderaan's Enemies: Zeph
records.description: A former Lieutenant of Al'Akir has opposed the rule of the new Windlord. This lieutenant, Zeph, has been setting up multiple ambushes against the Earthen Ring.

records.name: Thunderaan's Enemies: Alacris
records.description: A former Lieutenant of Al'Akir has sided with the Burning Legion. This lieutenant, Alacris, must be stopped before he sparks a rebellion from within Skywall.

records.name: Thunderaan's Enemies: Tulmos
records.description: A former Lieutenant of Al'Akir is seeking to undermine the war effort. This lieutenant, Tulmos, must be defeated before more lives are lost.

records.name: Return to the Firelands
records.description: PH

records.name: Janai's Famous Flaming Omelettes
records.description: Elementalist Janai has requested that we send a strike team to the Firelands to collect Cinderweb eggs for her research.

records.name: Troubling Tremors
records.description: On a recent expedition to Deepholm, one of our teams recorded strange seismic activity. These were not ordinary tremors... We should investigate further.

records.name: Twilight's Return
records.description: The dragon Zeryxia has been slain, but the Twilight's Hammer has not fully abandoned their efforts in Deepholm. We should send a strike team.

records.name: Trial of the Firelord
records.description: The elementals of the Firelands are engaged in an epic battle for supremacy. We must send our Champions to undergo a trial of strength.

records.name: [UNUSED]Spread the Word
records.description: The Uncrowned have been established, but we are going to need help.

records.name: The Big Bad Wolfe
records.description: Lord Ravenholdt has provided a sizeable sum of gold in order to entice Winstone Wolfe to work for the Uncrowned. "The Wolf" is staying at Ravenholdt Manor.

records.name: Freya's Spring: Harpy Mother
records.description: We were attacked by relentless harpies. Defend against the attack and take down their leader.

records.name: The Missing Vessel: Val'sharah
records.description: Andu'talah has fallen to the Nightmare, and Xavius seeks the power of the vessel. He hid a piece of it there. Retrieve it, so we can set a trap for Hakkar.

records.name: The Missing Vessel: Azsuna
records.description: The spirits at the Temple of a Thousand Lights have stolen a piece of the vessel, and are using it to empower themselves. Take it, so we can set a trap for Hakkar.

records.name: Additional Accoutrements
records.description: Matron Mother Malevolence has supplied you with a list of hard-to-find fel magic apparatuses. They will prove useful.

records.name: Back in Black
records.description: Belath Dawnblade has asked you to send your Ashtongue warriors to infiltrate the Black Temple. This will prepare you to confront Akama.

records.name: Working With the Wardens: Isle of the Watchers
records.description: When the Legion invaded the Vault of the Wardens, it wasn't just the Illidari who escaped. Sira Moonwarden has asked for our assistance.

records.name: Working With the Wardens: Skul'vrax
records.description: Sira Moonwarden is asking that we hunt down and either capture or kill the satyr known as Skul'vrax. His last known whereabouts were at the Tidal Marsh.

records.name: Working With the Wardens: Mellok, Son of Torok
records.description: Mellok, Son of Torok is a leader within the new Feltotem tribe, pledging himself to the Legion. The Wardens have asked us to deal with him.

records.name: Working With the Wardens: Fathnyr
records.description: A fel-corrupted storm dragon named Fathnyr occasionally ranges out from its Thorim's Peak aerie. The Wardens have been harassed by the beast.

records.name: Working With the Wardens: Mal'Dreth the Corruptor
records.description: An eredar named Mal'Dreth the Corruptor convinced several of the Warden adepts to turn traitor and work for the Burning Legion.

records.name: Impending Danger
records.description: A Legion command ship has appeared on the horizon. Send our champions to lead them away from the Wandering Isle!

records.name: Twisted Souls
records.description: Even in death, the souls of Azsuna cannot be at peace. Gilamore the Sinister has raised a company of spirit-mages. Stop her, and lay those souls to rest.

records.name: To Arms!
records.description: On the rocky northern coast of Stormheim, a sea giant has been causing havoc for all ships in the area. We need that coast cleared.

records.name: Weep for Water
records.description: At the base of the Weeping Bluffs, a disturbed water elemental is making it impossible for us to reach the wreckage of our sky-ships.

records.name: Symphony of Ruin
records.description: The Ruined Sanctum stands as a sad reminder of what has been lost to time. Yet its ancient guardian still stands watch. We should put Syphonus to rest.

records.name: Thing of Nightmares
records.description: At the edge of Nightmare, the satyr are spreading their influence right to the doorstep of Malorne's Refuge. Take out their leader, Kalazzius the Guileful.

records.name: Munitions Testing
records.description: Few creatures are as tough and resilient as the mountain ettin, and thus, they make the perfect target to test our munitions.

records.name: Marsh Cleanup
records.description: What was once a place of peace has become the realm of nightmare. Dreadful creatures spread darkness and filth through Val'sharah.

records.name: A Bitter Wind
records.description: The harpies of Highmountain will take any chance they get to harass and curse our allies, and steal our supplies. We should target them in their nests.

records.name: Glittering Seas
records.description: Not only do we have a murloc problem, we have a murloc that's stolen vrykul armor. See if you can put a stop to Grrvrgull the Conqueror.

records.name: On Dragons' Wings
records.description: High in the mountains over Stormheim, the matriarch of the Stormwing dragons builds her brood. We should slay her and her spawn.

records.name: A Gooey Job
records.description: One of our allies believes that Anax, the giant toad in Suramar, must secrete some kind of useful venom. Seek out Anax, and see what you can find.

records.name: Colossal Purge
records.description: Felsoul Hold is churning out infernals almost too fast for us to handle. We should purge their numbers, so the Legion cannot rain them down.

records.name: Don't Go In the Water
records.description: The local tribes have been terrorized by a giant fish lurking in the lakes of Highmountain. It's made off with a few of the fishermen as well.

records.name: Smashing Faces
records.description: Among the peaks of Highmountain, a lone ettin has been causing havoc for travelers traveling up the peak. Clear out Oubdob da Smasher.

records.name: Stormscourge
records.description: Our allies have hit a wall of storms in Galebroken Path, likely due to the awakened storm elemental raining down on them. Destroy Bladesquall.

records.name: Chill of the Grave
records.description: Undead kings and heroes aren't the only thing to worry about in the graveyards of the vrykul. Fjorlag, the Grave's Chill, stalks the living and dead.

records.name: Webspinners
records.description: Near Moonfall retreat in Suramar, spiders and their ilk have taken over the gardens. We should cut away their webs for our troops in that area.

records.name: Shadows and Husk
records.description: The once-idyllic gardens of Ambervale are now overrun by withered husks. Among them, Shal'an grows ever more powerful.

records.name: The Houndmaster
records.description: A worgen hunter by the name of Houndmaster Ely has taken it upon himself to hunt down the Forsaken, without regard for any chain of command.

records.name: Queen of Stone
records.description: A harpy matron, known as Seersei, has been constructing statues of remarkable life-like qualities in the forest of Val'sharah.

records.name: Harping On About It
records.description: Wormtalon harpies have taken over Shadowfen village, and the former residents seek some of their stolen valuables, as well as revenge. Provide both.

records.name: Giant Hoarders
records.description: While we usually don't mind a sea giant that eats murlocs, Bodash the Hoarder has begun targeting anything that comes close to his home.

records.name: Scrapping for Pieces
records.description: Not much can fend off trinket-stealing harpies, but Skullhat, a skull-wearing kobold of the Skywhisker tribe, has managed to hole up in the harpies' hills.

records.name: Inked
records.description: The vrykul infuse their tattoos with ancient magic, and hold their inkbinders in high regard. Destroying them will cripple the vrykul's ability to use that magic.

records.name: The Aspirant's Due
records.description: Outside the walls of Skold-Ashil, a disgraced and fallen shieldmaiden named Lagertha has been plotting to forcefully take her place among the Valkyra.

records.name: Castles in the Sand
records.description: Dalaran has requested a supply of pristine sand. The best source of this would be from the notorious sand elemental, Beacher.

records.name: What Lies Beneath
records.description: In Suramar, a vrykul warrior named Hertha Grimdottir has been lying in wait for travelers. Put an end to her.

records.name: Clearest Night
records.description: Once a caretaker of the spirits at Shield's Rest, Runeseer Sigvid has gone mad while the Helejar defile graves. Put him out of his misery.

records.name: The Mountain Stirs
records.description: In the Halls of the Mountain King, the drogbar and vrykul are conducting all manner of strange rituals, harnessing the power of the mountain. Put a stop to it.

records.name: Nightmare Ritual
records.description: Beneath the boughs of Dreadroot, a powerful satyr named Thondrax is harnessing the energies of the Rotwood in order to perform a nightmarish ritual.

records.name: Run Aground
records.description: The sea giants are notorious for causing shipwrecks, but one in particular will go out of his way to drag any vessel onto the rocky shores of Azsuna.

records.name: Candle in the Dark
records.description: Kobold legend speaks of a dark, devouring presence deep in the caverns of Highmountain. It is the reason kobolds fear the dark.

records.name: That's One Big Pile
records.description: The mages of Dalaran have requested a super dense fertilizer. The best material for this comes from the remains of Mac the Bear's meals, found in Azsuna.

records.name: Hide as White as Snow
records.description: The Highmountain tribes cherish the hide of a rare and elusive creature, the Majestic Elderhorn, for their most important ceremonies. Track the beast.

records.name: Overwatch
records.description: Watching over Skild-Ashil is the Ivory Sentinel, a titan construct made to ward off the unworthy. We must prove that our champions are mightier.

records.name: The Dead Exist in the Past
records.description: Overlooking Bradensbrook, the malicious ghost of Kiranys Duskwhisper defies any attempt to contain or dislodge him from his vigil.

records.name: Elfbane
records.description: The Koralune ettin make the gardens of Ambervale their home in Suramar. One has been causing havoc, particularly if someone is an elf.

records.name: Trophy Hunting
records.description: A satyr named Perrexx has been making sport out of hunting the druids of Moonclaw Vale, as though they were trophies! Turn the tables on him.

records.name: The Drake Wrestler
records.description: The vrykul have employed some unorthodox methods to tame storm drakes. One such tamer is Glimar Ironfist, the drake-wrestler.

records.name: Feeding Time
records.description: The Skyhorn tribe in Highmountain has come under attack from a very large roc named Crawshuk the Hungry. The roc is causing terror in the village.

records.name: No Crab Pots Needed
records.description: The war has put a strain on supplies, and the troops crave fresh meat. A gigantic river crab named Tideclaw should provide enough to last them a while.

records.name: Tainted Tap Water
records.description: Even in Dalaran, we must be ever vigilant for threats. The Legion have infiltrated through the sewers and seek to taint the drinking water of the citizens.

records.name: Preparations for Invasion: Scouting their Hold
records.description: Allari wants you to send your forces to scout Felsoul Hold in Suramar. Once there, they are to identify likely capture targets.

records.name: Preparations for Invasion: Weapon Improvements
records.description: Not everyone has a set of artifact warglaives. If we are to invade a demon world, it would be best if the Illidari received improved weapons.

records.name: Preparations for Invasion: Snatch and Grab
records.description: Now that the Legion targets at Felsoul Hold have been observed for a while, it is time to send your most capable in to capture them.

records.name: Preparations for Invasion: Ship-Shape
records.description: It has been many years since the Fel Hammer was in full operational order. Jace needs all hands on deck to help out with some necessary maintenance.

records.name: Preparations for Invasion: Where Are the Felsouls?!
records.description: With the captured demons safely trapped below deck on the Fel Hammer, Allari is ready to apply her tender mercies and use the Scythe of Souls.

records.name: Spread the Word
records.description: The Knights of the Ebon Blade have been established at Acherus, but we will need allies in our fight against the Legion.  Send Nazgrim to counter this threat.

records.name: Troops in the Field
records.description: Now that we have bolstered our numbers, we should display our might and place our troops in the field. The sea giants should be a suitable test of their skill.

records.name: Spread the Word
records.description: We've established Netherlight Temple as a sanctuary, but now it's time to send Calia Menethil to spread the word about its existence and enlist others.

records.name: Troops in Training
records.description: Now that we have recruited some troops, we can use them to bolster our champions' efforts.  Send them out on a routine scouting mission.

records.name: Don't Call Him Scruffy
records.description: The Highmountain tribe have been afraid to leave their homes at night, thanks to a large cat prowling the border of the village.

records.name: Artifact: Aluneth, Greatstaff of the Magna
records.description: Aluneth was most notably wielded for a time by Aegwynn, the only female Guardian of Tirisfal, although stories indicate that it is far older than she. After passing from her hands, it was eventually locked away in a secret vault, where it remains still.

records.name: Artifact: Felo'melorn
records.description: "Flamestrike" in its native tongue, Felo'melorn was borne into battle by members of the Sunstrider family. Ultimately, the sword was lost in Northrend.

records.name: Artifact: Ebonchill
records.description: Alodi's greatstaff, Ebonchill, was the bane of many demons in the Legion. After he retired his mantle of Guardian, the staff passed down through his apprentices, eventually lost to time. None know where it resides now, save perhaps Alodi himself.

records.name: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Dalaran
records.description: If we're going to throw SI:7 off our trail, we need to make a show of it. Let's start some false intrigue on our very own Archmage Khadgar.

records.name: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Stormheim
records.description: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has disappeared in Stormheim. Let SI:7 think we are hot on her trail. We are, but we will assign a decoy agent for SI:7 to notice.

records.name: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Azsuna
records.description: We have a deep contact on the ground in Azsuna. He goes by many names, including Mr. Shackle. Send some people down there to "interfere" with him.

records.name: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Highmountain
records.description: The Highmountain tribes are outstanding warriors, hunters, and shaman. What they are not is stealthy. Setup surveillance of each tribe's camps.

records.name: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail: Suramar
records.description: There is something with the nightborne in Suramar. Unfortunately, their city has too much protection. However, we should let SI:7 see us trying.

records.name: Gathering the Dreamweavers: Graham Silverclaw
records.description: A young druid with great potential, Graham Silverclaw, led our scouts to the edge of Suramar. But he ran into a Legion hunting party, and he needs assistance.

records.name: Powering the Portal: Ashenvale
records.description: Even in the forests of Ashenvale, the satyr, led by Rethazar the Fallen, have been spotted, and they may soon attack outright.

records.name: Powering the Portal: Moonglade
records.description: The doom guard Metreon has rallied the satyr of Felwood, and they have attacked Moonglade itself! We cannot allow Moonglade to fall to the Legion.

records.name: Powering the Portal: Andu'talah
records.description: Those who were once our friends have been claimed by the Nightmare, and the dryad keepers near Andu'talah are among those fallen.

records.name: Powering the Portal: Kal'delar
records.description: We've received word that Oracle Tidecress, a powerful naga sorceress, has been meeting with the Darkfiend satyr. Slay her and her comrades.

records.name: 99.0 [reuse me]
records.description: 99.0 [reuse me]

records.name: [PH]
records.description: [PH]

records.name: Relieving the Front Lines
records.description: Priests from all over Azeroth have been aiding our allies on the front lines since the Burning Legion began its invasion. It is time to send in some relief.

records.name: Holy Ground: Light's Hope Chapel
records.description: Since the days of the Argent Dawn, Light's Hope Chapel has been a beacon of the Light on Azeroth. Travel there and collect a fragment of Light.

records.name: Holy Ground: The Exodar
records.description: The priests of the Exodar have preserved a long tradition of the Light. Collect a fragment from the Exodar, and beware: the Legion may be drawn to it.

records.name: Holy Ground: Uther's Tomb
records.description: Uther the Lightbringer was the first paladin of the Knights of the Silver Hand, and never faltered from his beliefs. His grave is sacred to followers of the Light, but it may also draw evil spirits.

records.name: Holy Ground: Auchindoun
records.description: Deep beneath Auchindoun, the naaru D'ore has been regenerating into a being of pure Light once more. Seek out this holy shrine.

records.name: Holy Ground: The Sunwell
records.description: The Legion will do everything it can to stop us from revitalizing the wisp, and seek to intercept us before we can collect the last fragment.

records.name: Infiltrating Our Enemies
records.description: In order to fulfill Velen's prophecy, we must infiltrate our enemies and find out if any among them could make a potential ally.

records.name: Lumenstone: Faronaar
records.description: The eredar at Faronaar smith weapons out of lumenstone. Strike at their forges and take the metal we seek, dealing a double blow to our enemies.

records.name: Lumenstone: Suramar City
records.description: The nightborne of Suramar city are studying the properties of lumenstone to augment their constructs. Break into the city and steal their supplies.

records.name: Lumenstone: Stormheim
records.description: Our scouts report that the vrykul have acquired a cache of lumenstone weapons, and they intend to melt them down to create armor for their drakes.

records.name: Lumenstone: Broken Shore
records.description: The demons have left lumenstone weapons scattered all over the Broken Shore. If we move fast, we can recover those weapons.

records.name: Lumenstone: Vashj'ir
records.description: Long ago, a shipment of lumenstone was lost overboard during a terrible storm above Vashj'ir. Unfortunately, the naga may have found it before us.

records.name: Securing Mardum
records.description: There are still pockets of the brood queen's forces scattered about below us on Mardum. They could prove a threat to the Fel Hammer.

records.name: Where In the World is Mathias?: Obvious Start
records.description: The Broken Shore is the obvious location to begin our search for Master Mathias Shaw. We must determine where the Legion is holding him.

records.name: Where In the World is Mathias?: Black Rook Hold
records.description: Mathias is being moved around. Detheroc is a clever dreadlord. The trail leads to Black Rook Hold. Too bad you did not notice him before.

records.name: Where In the World is Mathias?: Altar of End Times
records.description: The command center known as the Altar of End Times floats above Faronaar in Azsuna. Break in and have a look around.

records.name: Where In the World is Mathias?: Gates of Valor
records.description: The Burning Legion has a powerful ally in the vrykul God-King Skovald. Perhaps they are holding Mathias Shaw at the Gates of Valor.

records.name: Where In the World is Mathias?: SI:7
records.description: We seem to have run out of leads. Time to do the impossible. Time to sneak into SI:7 headquarters and see if Detheroc has left any clues for us.

records.name: Blood of Our Enemy: Stormheim
records.description: At the gates of the Hall of Valor, the Felskorn have assembled, including a massive brute named Cleaver Northamel. Slay him, and collect his blood.

records.name: Blood of Our Enemy: Val'sharah
records.description: The druids at Val'sharah have their hands full with the satyr and the Nightmare. We can help by destroying a rampaging satyr warband, led by Illbringer Zizzifrax.

records.name: Blood of Our Enemy: Highmountain
records.description: The Legion has desecrated the sacred burial sites of the Highmountain tribe, raising the bodies of the dead. We should put them back to rest.

records.name: Blood of Our Enemy: Azsuna
records.description: In the Felbeast Dens, the Legion creates terrifyingly resilient breeds of manastalkers. We should disrupt their operation by killing Felbreeder Argnotha.

records.name: Blood of Our Enemy: Suramar
records.description: In Felsoul Hold, giant infernals and felbats attack any who come near. Dispose of a few, and collect their blood for our use.

records.name: Emissary to the Priests
records.description: We need to send an emissary to the priests at Netherlight Temple. However, there may be danger along the way. Let us send Maxwell Tyrosus.

records.name: Investigate the Halls of Valor
records.description: Word has reached us that another titan relic may reside in the Halls of Valor, far above Stormheim. We should investigate.

records.name: Salanar the Horseman
records.description: If we are to bring about the return of the Four Horsemen, then we will need to acquire suitable steeds. Send word for Salanar the Horsemen to come to Acherus.

records.name: Fallen Steeds: Saddle of the Frozen Crown
records.description: Salanar the Horseman requires the saddle of Invincible, the former steed of Arthas Menethil. Since the defeat of Arthas, it has been lost beneath Icecrown.

records.name: Fallen Steeds: The Baron's Saddle
records.description: Salanar the Horseman requires the saddle of Deathcharger, the former steed of Baron Rivendare. Following his defeat, the saddle was returned to Stratholme.

records.name: Fallen Steeds: Saddle of the Headless Horseman
records.description: Salanar the Horseman requires the saddle used by the great Sir Thomas, the Headless Horseman. The saddle is buried in the cemetery of the Scarlet Monastery.

records.name: Fallen Steeds: Saddle of the Huntsman
records.description: Salanar the Horseman requires the saddle of Midnight, the steed of Attumen the Huntsman. The saddle should be found somewhere within the ruins of Karazhan.

records.name: Fallen Steeds: Reins of Shadow
records.description: Salanar the Horseman requires the Shadow Reins used by an ancient Dark Rider. They can only be obtained by defeating one of the Dark Riders directly.

records.name: Investigate Darkheart Thicket
records.description: Even in shade form, Xavius can exert his power over Shaladrassil and torments our allies. We should investigate how far the corruption has reached.

records.name: Investigate the Violet Hold
records.description: The Violet Hold in Dalaran contains some of the most dangerous creatures ever captured. We cannot allow it to fall to the Legion. Investigate!

records.name: Investigate Neltharion's Lair
records.description: Even after his fall, Deathwing leaves devastation in his wake. The drogbar have built beneath the mountain, and may have obtained a powerful artifact.

records.name: Investigate the Eye of Azshara
records.description: Though she hasn't made an appearance herself, Queen Azshara still controls the naga with an iron will, and is rumored to be after a powerful relic.

records.name: Investigate the Maw of Souls
records.description: Not all vrykul travel to the Halls of Valor. The damned and accursed are rumored to go to the Maw of Souls, a dreadful ship sailing an endless sea.

records.name: Investigate The Arcway
records.description: Suramar City is an architectural marvel, but its reach goes far beyond the glittering spires and avenues above. We should investigate below.

records.name: Unholy Attainment: Essence of Undeath
records.description: Grand Apothecary Putress was once a trusted advisor to Sylvanas. He deserved his end, but he may still prove useful. Harvest the Essence of Undeath from his soul in the Shadowlands.

records.name: Unholy Attainment: Essence of Fear
records.description: Consumed by fear, Grand Empress Shek'zeer spread devastation. Her death was a blessing to the Pandaren... and now to us as well. Harvest the Essence of Fear from her soul in the Shadowlands.

records.name: Unholy Attainment: Essence of Shadow
records.description: A manipulator and traitor, Soulbinder Nyami wielded powerful shadow magic in life. In death, she is the perfect vessel for the Essence of Shadow. Harvest the essence from her soul in the Shadowlands.

records.name: Unholy Attainment: Essence of Hatred
records.description: After the death of his son, Admiral Daelin Proudmoore was consumed by the thirst for revenge. Collect the Essence of Hatred from his soul in the Shadowlands.

records.name: Unholy Attainment: Essence of Darkness
records.description: Once a Gilnean archmage, Arugal unleashed the worgen, and they attacked both friend and foe. Collect the Essence of Darkness from his soul in the Shadowlands.

records.name: Investigate Black Rook Hold
records.description: The dead rise from their graves at Black Rook Hold, and we believe that even long-deceased members of the Ravencrest family walk again.

records.name: Investigate the Court of Stars
records.description: Even in a time of turmoil, the citizens of Suramar do their best to get on with daily life. However, there may be valuable intel from the Court of Stars.

records.name: Investigate the Vault of the Wardens
records.description: When Cordana Felsong betrayed the Wardens, Maiev Shadowsong was forced to unleash all prisoners within the Vault. We should investigate.

records.name: Facing Our Fears
records.description: Val'sharah is being consumed by the Nightmare. Before we can face the darkness, send our forces to investigate the heart of the corruption.

records.name: Investigate Felsoul Hold
records.description: Before we can break our way to the other side, we will need to find the best place to steal a Legion gateway. Felsoul Hold is a candidate.

records.name: On the Trail of the Great Worm
records.description: Jorhuttam, the great worm, swallowed whole the fabled Gjallerhorn. Send your champions to track the beast!

records.name: Lumenstone: Faronaar
records.description: The demons keep a rich stockpile of weapons at Legion Camp: Ruin in Azsuna. Assault the enemies there and return with any lumenstone that you can find.

records.name: Lumenstone: Suramar City
records.description: The nightborne are moving a large shipment of lumenstone behind the city walls. Invade under cover of darkness and claim the steel for our order!

records.name: Lumenstone: Stormheim
records.description: Our scouts stumbled upon a vrykul raiding party equipped with lumenstone weapons. We can deal a double blow - eliminate the enemy, and take their weapons for our own.

records.name: Lumenstone: Broken Shore
records.description: The Broken Shore is littered with debris from battle, with plenty of lumenstone to gather. Just beware of the demons still patrolling the area.

records.name: Lumenstone: Val'sharah
records.description: The naga in southern Val'sharah are using weapons crafted from lumenstone. We'll have to convince the naga to part with it.

records.name: A More Wretched Hive of Scum and Villainy
records.description: To attract new rogues, thieves, and other sundry scoundrels, you need to make Lonika Stillblade an offer she can't refuse. Send Vanessa VanCleef.

records.name: Spy vs. Spy
records.description: The Alliance's intelligence agency, SI:7, has been acting very strange of late. Send our agents into Stormwind City to spy on them and gather intel.

records.name: Convincin' Old Yancey
records.description: In order to press gang more cutthroats into the ranks of the Uncrowned, Fleet Admiral Tethys wants our finest. A pirate, Yancey Grillsen, would be perfect.

records.name: More Than They Can Chew
records.description: As well-intentioned as some warlocks may be, they sometimes get carried away. A pair of warlocks have a fragile containment on a doomlord.

records.name: Predator and Prey
records.description: The Tideskorn vrykul pride themselves on their hunting skills, and none more so than Huntress Estrid with her fearsome companion, Halfdan.

records.name: Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
records.description: Deep in the Bitestone Caverns, a gigantic basilisk has been absorbing the latent power of crystals into its armor.

records.name: Roaring Matron
records.description: The Feathermane have recently become hunted. A singing owlcat named Rauren has been tempting the surviving Feathermane kittens away.

records.name: Polluted Waters
records.description: The Nightmare has seeped into the waterways of Val'sharah, corrupting even powerful elemental creatures. Pollous the Fetid disrupts the river.

records.name: Reaving History
records.description: The Soultakers are an organized trio of Helarjar vrykul, intent on plundering the tombs of their own kings. Stop them, before they can do more damage.

records.name: The Terror that Flaps in the Day
records.description: The Legion breeds felbats as flying mounts for their soldiers, but one in particular has grown so large it darkens the sky with its wings.

records.name: Never Enough
records.description: Once a librarian of the Kirin Tor, Normantis the Deposed never forgave the damage done by Malygos and the blue flight in Northrend.

records.name: Broken Wings
records.description: Even powerful druids have succumbed to the Nightmare in Shala'nir. One of them, Lyrath Moonfeather, used to embody balance and harmony.

records.name: Undisputed Heavyweight
records.description: A famous boxing champion in Highmountain has issued a challenge to everyone: Whoever can last three rounds with him will be rewarded handsomely.

records.name: Running in the Sun
records.description: A vicious beast, Daggerbeak, has been preying on the equine sunrunners in the open glades of Azsuna. The poor creatures are terrified.

records.name: An Apple a Day Keeps the Legion Away
records.description: We have reason to suspect that a Legion agent has successfully infiltrated the city of Dalaran, and is now posing as a simple fruit vendor.

records.name: A Shocking Confrontation
records.description: A rift has split right through the ley-ruins, discharging dangerous amounts of energy. We should destroy as many ley-creatures as we can.

records.name: Captain of the Damned
records.description: The Soultakers are an organized trio of Helarjar vrykul, intent on plundering the tombs of their own kings. Stop them, before they can do more damage.

records.name: No Matter How Many Times We Tell Them...
records.description: The warlocks in Azsuna are at it again, summoning demons they can't possibly hope to control. We can't always fight more fire with fire.

records.name: A Change of Pace
records.description: The drogbar have an underground snail-racing ring deep in their caverns. Recently, a vicious fight broke out. We should investigate.

records.name: Ironbranch
records.description: A corrupted Ancient of War, Ironbranch, resides deep in the overrun grove of Shala'nir. Other nightmarish creatures flock to him.

records.name: A Thirst for Knowledge
records.description: Deep in the vaults of the Arcway, the eredar are stealing knowledge vital to our allies, and they may discover a weakness.

records.name: Soulstealing
records.description: The Soultakers are an organized trio of Helarjar vrykul, intent on plundering the tombs of their own kings. Stop them!

records.name: Encounter at Krasus' Landing
records.description: A fel-crazed vrykul warrior has broken through the outer defenses of Dalaran, and made it all the way to Krasus' landing!

records.name: Block the Rook
records.description: Black Rook Hold has been overrun by the spirits of the damned. The long-dead Theryssia rises from her grave, attacking anyone.

records.name: Manasaber Matron
records.description: Over time, the natural ley energy and mana fields of Suramar have altered the wildlife. Myonix, the matron of the manasabers, is a terrifying beast.

records.name: Enthralled Energy
records.description: The nightborne have been drawing on the energies of the Starweaver's Sanctum, summoning terrible creatures of pure energy.

records.name: Frozen in Stone
records.description: The manascale basilisks have been driven out of their caves, and their petrifying gaze is turning anyone - including other wildlife - completely to stone.

records.name: Moonfall Nests
records.description: The nightborne are slaughtering Moonfall hippogryphs by the flock, and their nests are under attack. We must put a stop to it.

records.name: The Aspirant
records.description: In the heart of Suramar City, some nightborne have embraced the Legion's 'gifts' more readily than others. Miasu must be stopped.

records.name: Singed Feathers
records.description: Few beasts are as dangerous and terrifying as Charfeather, an alpha owlcat that does not fear any hunter. Dispose of Charfeather.

records.name: Never Sated
records.description: A monstrous Withered named Valakar the Thirsty has been drawn to the latent ley-energies of Azsuna, and seeks to consume everything in his path.

records.name: Bait and Switch
records.description: The Thistleleaf sprites have been baiting unwary travelers into their groves, by placing what appears to be unguarded treasure right out in the open.

records.name: Crush the Slavemasters
records.description: The Hatecoil naga have been capturing sailors off the coast of Azsuna, and forcing them to work for the sea giants of the coves.

records.name: Mak'rana Menace
records.description: The Mak'rana of Azsuna have been riled up by all our activity on the coast, and they're now chopping holes in any ships that come near.

records.name: Saber Matriarch
records.description: Deep in the walls of Black Rook Hold, even the war sabers have been raised from death. The matriarch Darkshade watches over her unnatural brood.

records.name: Murky Waters
records.description: The Murkwater naga have taken over the ruins of Kal'delar, far too close to our outposts in Val'sharah. We should target their most powerful warriors.

records.name: Lord of the Jungle
records.description: Deep in the forests of Val'sharah, a lone saber has been ambushing any traveler that wanders too close to his den. Hunt down Bahagar.

records.name: Smolderhide Problem
records.description: With our resources stretched thin across the Broken Isles, even the furbolg tribes of Val'sharah are pushing into new territory.

records.name: Stinging Nightmare
records.description: The Nightmare has the wasps into a deadly frenzy. The greatest of the wasps, Mahajik, is large enough to kill with a single sting. Destroy Mahajik.

records.name: Gornoth the Lost
records.description: Perhaps driven out from the hills by his brethren, Gornoth the Lost only knows how to wander and how to kill. We should seek him out and kill him.

records.name: Prince of the Hill
records.description: Of the same cut as his father, Hill Prince Urgo is destined to be lord of the dangerous hill ettin tribes in Highmountain. We should strike at him.

records.name: Rocks For Brains
records.description: With all the upheaval in Highmountain, the Ambershard elementals are pouring out of their caverns and threatening the Highmountain tribes.

records.name: Feltotem Hounds
records.description: The Feltotem tribe in Highmountain have bred demonic hounds to serve as guardians. We should cull their numbers.

records.name: Lost and Blind
records.description: The Blind Marshlands live up to their name, as thick fog and mist conceal the sad horrors within. We should put the long-dead back to rest.

records.name: Squids Patrol These Waters
records.description: Deep in the waters of Helheim, a terrifying helsquid named Soulthirster preys on any unfortunate soul to step in the water. Dispatch the squid.

records.name: The Dread Captain
records.description: Among Helya's fleet of ships, bearing damned souls on the sea for all eternity, Captain Dargun's crew is among the most feared. Destroy him.

records.name: Dogs of Death
records.description: Helya's helhounds are a fearsome pack of predators, but Fenri is a three-headed beast bred for terror and despair. Find him in the depths of Helheim.

records.name: Cannibal Vrykul
records.description: For meat, Hannval the Butcher has slaughtered beasts and men for his terrible table. Find him in the hills of Stormheim and put an end to the feast.

records.name: Dragonblood
records.description: In the Field of Forgotten Kings, Oktel Dragonblood no longer rests peacefully in his grave. He was among the first to ride dragons. Defeat him.

records.name: They're In the Walls
records.description: Our scouts report that Legion agents have been trying to infiltrate Dalaran through its own citizens. We should investigate and unmask any enemies.

records.name: Glowing Foundations
records.description: While the mages of Dalaran know to float a city, they sometimes forget about the cracks in the foundation. Latent energy has come to life there.

records.name: Waking the Dead
records.description: Late at night, someone has been going to the cemetery in Dalaran and attempting to raise the dead. We should investigate and put a stop to it.

records.name: Walking on Broken Glass
records.description: Someone has been shattering windows throughout Dalaran, leaving a trail of destruction and broken glass. Investigate and find the culprit.

records.name: Another Rat Problem
records.description: Dalaran is no stranger to rats, but they've become even more of a nuisance than usual in the Underbelly. See what's causing all the fuss.

records.name: Aiding the Valkyra
records.description: The Valkyra are under attack by Felskorn vrykul. Aid them and crush those who've betrayed Odyn.

records.name: Lost at Sea
records.description: Powerful armaments were lost when the great ship Vaesska sank at sea.  Send your armies to retrieve them and strengthen our forces!

records.name: Enslaved by Sea Giants
records.description: A group of mighty warriors loyal to Odyn has been captured by sea giants and are being forced to fight in their underground pit. Free them!

records.name: Glittering Treasure
records.description: Our scouts report that the Britterbrine came across a cache that may have come from Azshara's treasure room. We should see what we can bring back.

records.name: Win the Crowd
records.description: The nightborne pride themselves on the great heights they've achieved with their civilization. Send our champions to their tournament.

records.name: Black Rook Rumble
records.description: At Raven's Glory Arena in Black Rook Hold, our champions can prove their worth and earn respect for our cause. Send them to the Rumble.

records.name: Might of the Mountain
records.description: The Highmountain tauren have requested our aid to protect their borders from the Feltotem. In return, their ritualists will grant us powerful potions.

records.name: Blood of a Titan
records.description: Our scouts report that the Legion is experimenting with the properties of Sargeras' own blood, in order to bolster their armies. We should send our champions to acquire the blood for ourselves.

records.name: It's so FLUFFY!
records.description: Amalia, famous battle-pet tamer, has a litter of corgi puppies she needs to find homes for! To determine a rightful owner, she's holding a tournament.

records.name: Friends, Not Food
records.description: Master Tamer Flummox isn't the most conventional pet tamer. Now, he's acquired a firebat pup and means to eat it! Rescue the pup from certain doom.

records.name: Things Gaardoun Needs
records.description: To train new broken warriors how to deal with the new Burning Legion, Battlelord Gaardoun is requesting that you gather demonic implements.

records.name: Preparing Our Arrival
records.description: Felsoul Hold was not suitable for our plans, but there is one other option. Scout out the area around Felblaze Ingress, to see if we have any hope.

records.name: Last Chance
records.description: The Legion gateway in Felblaze Ingress is the only place powerful enough to take your armies to Niskara. Hymdall will need to wrest it from the Legion first.

records.name: On the Hunt
records.description: Nightborne nobles are planning to hunt an elusive, rare fox, possibly the last of his kind. Send your champions to uncover more information.

records.name: Securing an Invitation
records.description: According to the Stablemaster, only certain nightborne nobles are invited to the hunt. Send your champions to question Lord Nimrod about the hunt.

records.name: All Dressed Up
records.description: After taking Lord Nimrod's hunt invitation, we must discover where the fox hunt will begin. Send your champions to question Lady Dyana on the location.

records.name: Just in Time
records.description: One last piece of the map remains and you will be ready to stop the nightborne's fox hunt. Send your champions to confront Houndmaster Britomar.

records.name: Swarm, Swarm!
records.description: The Hatecoil naga have stirred up the Salteye murlocs, who are now threatening the Ruins of Nar'thalas. They need to be pushed back.

records.name: Out of Hibernation
records.description: The Llothien grizzlies have voracious appetites, and the cliffwing nest right on the ground. It's too tempting a target for hungry bears.

records.name: Ripe for the Picking
records.description: Though many parts of Val'sharah have been overrun, the corrupted flora may provide valuable insight into the properties of the Nightmare.

records.name: Oh, Deer
records.description: The Nightmare has corrupted once-peaceful creatures of the forest, including a herd of stags and does. Put them out of their misery.

records.name: Spelunking
records.description: There are many paths to the great caverns in Highmountain, but some are more dangerous than others. Explore to see if there's a better way inside.

records.name: Hazardous Materials
records.description: The Feltotem have poisoned the waterways of Highmountain with their dreadful rituals, sickening the wildlife. Put a stop to it.

records.name: Shark Frenzy
records.description: Many ships have run aground on the coast of Stormheim, and the sharks are a menace for survivors. Dispose of a few, so the sailors can rebuild.

records.name: The Undying
records.description: Hidden in the cliffs of Stormheim, undying spirits keep a watch, despite having long passed on. Bring them some resolution to their vigil.

records.name: Too Many Legs
records.description: The Ruins of Falanaar are a dangerous place, especially for any that are wary of arachnids. Thin out the number of Lurkers there.

records.name: Border Incursion
records.description: The forests of Val'sharah have been overrun by Nightmare, and that terror now creeps across into Suramar. Push the satyrs and their defilers back.

records.name: Turtle Soup
records.description: On the Timeworn Strand, gigantic turtles wander the ancient ruins. Their meat would go a long way to supporting our troops. Beware of naga though.

records.name: A Terrible Vintage
records.description: In the Lost Orchard, specters brew an arcane-aged wine so awful, it would serve as a decent poison. Disrupt their ghostly operations.

records.name: Got Your Goat
records.description: In the shadow of Black Rook Hold, herds of innocent goats have been terrorized by risen hounds. The farmers depend on those goats for their livelihood.

records.name: Deep Dark
records.description: Our scouts report a system of natural caverns beneath Black Rook Hold. We should investigate to see if they are as fortified as the castle above.

records.name: Worse Than Death
records.description: The Swamprock murlocs of Shipwreck Cove have a long history of grabbing survivors from wrecks and dragging them back to their village.

records.name: Death Scavengers
records.description: The wyrmtongue are scavenging the graves of the Highmountain tauren, courtesy of the Feltotem incursion. Teach them a lesson in respecting the dead.

records.name: The Star Buck
records.description: Usually, the squallhunter drakes prey on the stags of Stormheim, but one stag has turned the tables, slaughtering dragons. Hunt down this beast.

records.name: The Lone Dragon
records.description: Storm drakes normally live in colonies or are tamed by the vrykul, but one lone drake does neither. Instead, it preys on everyone.

records.name: The Holdouts
records.description: Many Moonfall Acolytes are still trapped after the Nightfallen attacked the Moon Guard Stronghold. Send in some aid for those left behind.

records.name: Nasty Neighbors
records.description: Harpies have moved into the ruins of Tel'anor, destroying the once-beautiful buildings with their foul nests. Dispose of them.

records.name: Ruin Cats
records.description: In the Ruins of Llothien, the prowlers have taken over. No one can study or investigate the ruins until their numbers are culled some.

records.name: A Tale of Two Suramars
records.description: Suramar is split between crumbling ruins and glittering civilization, yet neither is completely safe. Investigate where we can be the most help.

records.name: Perilous Seas
records.description: Azsuna's coast is littered with shipwrecks and hazards wrought by its hostile inhabitants. Search for and destroy any lingering threats.

records.name: Demonic Influence
records.description: The demons of Faronaar extend their influence deep into Azsuna, corrupting any and all they can. Search, and dispose of any under the Legion's thumb.

records.name: Trail of Breadcrumbs
records.description: The forests of Val'sharah are no place to wander off alone. Danger waits behind every tree, and sometimes it doesn't wait.

records.name: Bad Dreams
records.description: The Nightmare has corrupted the roots of Shaladrassil and many creatures within Val'sharah. Seek out and dispose of the crooked elements.

records.name: Keep Your Guard Up
records.description: It's not just the pathways of Highmountain that are cause for concern. Some of the greatest threats lie in wait for the unwary.

records.name: Crumbling Caverns
records.description: Scouts report geological instability in Highmountain, where something must be moving just beneath the surface. Investigate and destroy.

records.name: Unworthy
records.description: Not all vrykul will ascend to the halls of Valarjar, and those are desperate to avoid the turmoil of Helheim. They will do anything to earn honor.

records.name: Titan's Gaze
records.description: It is said that the Titan watchers themselves observe all the residents of Stormheim, and who is worthy to ascend. Prove our worth.

records.name: Forgotten Knowledge
records.description: The nightborne have preserved a culture across thousands of years, but not everything is so civilized and pristine. Investigate what lies beneath.

records.name: Seeping Energies
records.description: Despite being half-ruined, the latent energies in Suramar attract creatures of all sorts. Explore the ruins and discover what feeds on this power.

records.name: Ancient Secrets
records.description: The elven ruins of Azsuna hold secrets we can't begin to comprehend. Search and rediscover what has been lost to time.

records.name: Dangerous Fields
records.description: The denizens of Azsuna, whether natural or unnatural, are a dangerous sort. Be wary while traveling through the area.

records.name: Darkened Skies
records.description: The nights in Val'sharah are filled with the howls of disturbed creatures. Investigate the cause and put them out of their misery.

records.name: Non-Motherly Nature
records.description: Creatures in Val'sharah were hardly tame before the Nightmare crept in, and corrupting energies have made them even more dangerous.

records.name: Evergreen
records.description: Though mostly covered in rocky hills and snowy cliffs, Highmountain also has its forests, with their own beauties and dangers.

records.name: Soaring Peaks
records.description: The tauren of Highmountain have learned to live with the perilous landscape, but more than just cliffs and peaks endanger the tribes.

records.name: Stormy Skies
records.description: Not only the vrykul threaten anyone who enters the hills of Stormheim. Sometimes danger strikes from the sky.

records.name: Shadow of Helya
records.description: Dangers creep from the Helmouth, and even the dead are not safe in their graves. Investigate Stormheim and fight back against death itself.

records.name: The Neverending Threat
records.description: Demons simply don't know when they're beaten. Even now, they plot to invade parts of Suramar. Investigate, and stop them.

records.name: The Neverending Threat
records.description: Demons simply don't know when they're beaten. Even now, they plot to invade parts of Suramar. Investigate, and stop them.

records.name: Mikros - 7.0 Test Mission
records.description: Should give you a huge success chance boost, if it's the first mission of the day. Also should give you a cool item!

records.name: An Odious Task
records.description: Lucian from One Last Glass was overheard lamenting the loss of a shipment of extraodinarly stinky cheese.  Apparently the courier was overrun as he made his way through the Underbelly.

records.name: A Rare Vintage
records.description: There was once a great stock of wine in Falanaar.  Send some troops to investigate and see what they can find.

records.name: What Lurks Beneath the Tower?
records.description: Karazhan stirs. Send our forces to investigate the tower.

records.name: There is no Brawlers Guild
records.description: Now that you've found your way into the guild, it seems only fair that your champions should be allowed to participate.

records.name: Council of War
records.description: The Warhammer Council is a fearsome foe.

records.name: Its Clean Up Time
records.description: Wait, a janitor? Really?

records.name: A Good Dust Up
records.description: There's nothing quite like the thrill of defending the honor of your faction and engaging in some friendly, or not so friendly, competition. Send your champion to explore the battlegrounds.

records.name: Once More Into the Fray
records.description: The melee continues in the battleground. Send our forces to assist the cause.

records.name: The Greatest Stage of All
records.description: There's nothing quite like the sound of the crowd cheering as you deftly maneuver and muscle for rank. Send your champions to the arenas to see what they can learn.

records.name: The Perils of Ashran
records.description: Your champions have heard of a place of endless war, where the tides of battle flow constantly. Send them to investigate further.

records.name: Master of Shadows
records.description: Are you afraid of the dark?

records.name: I've Got A Strange Feeling About This
records.description: Can you defeat Meatball?

records.name: Armies of Legionfall
records.description: We need support for our return to the Broken Shore. Go to the other class leaders and request their aid.

records.name: Armies of Legionfall
records.description: If we wish for our offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.

records.name: Armies of Legionfall

records.name: Armies of Legionfall
records.description: If we wish for an offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.

records.name: Gathering the Dreamweavers: Graham Silverclaw
records.description: A young druid with great potential, Graham Silverclaw, led our scouts to the edge of Suramar. But he ran into a Legion hunting party, and he needs assistance.

records.name: Fallen Steeds: Reins of Shadow
records.description: Salanar the Horseman requires the Shadow Reins used by an ancient Dark Rider. They can only be obtained by defeating one of the Dark Riders directly.

records.name: Armies of Legionfall
records.description: We need support for our return to the Broken Shore. Go to the other class leaders and request their aid.

records.name: Unholy Attainment: Essence of Darkness
records.description: Once a Gilnean archmage, Arugal unleashed the worgen, and they attacked both friend and foe. Collect the Essence of Darkness from his soul in the Shadowlands.

records.name: Armies of Legionfall
records.description: If we wish for an offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.

records.name: Armies of Legionfall
records.description: If we wish for an offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.

records.name: Armies of Legionfall
records.description: If we wish for an offensive on the Broken Shore to succeed, we must form an alliance with the other orders of Azeroth.

records.name: Menace on the Broken Shore
records.description: Dispatch champions to investigate Legion activities on the Broken Shore.

records.name: That Which Shatters Worlds
records.description: Lumbering across the land is a Legion infernal of monstrous proportions. Dispatch our forces to bring it down.

records.name: Terrors in the Sky
records.description: Before we can fully scout the Broken Shore, we must clear the skies of Legion threats.

records.name: Hope Betrayed
records.description: It is said the demon Dantalionax can drain all hope from the hearts of mortals. Our forces need him eradicated.

records.name: Hard Target
records.description: We must send a team to scout the gates of the Tomb of Sargeras. Be aware: this is likely a one-way mission.

records.name: Recover the Wounded
records.description: We have wounded trapped on the Broken Shore! Dispatch your champions to bring them home.

records.name: Portal Disruption
records.description: Eredar mages are using portals to bring reinforcements to the Broken Shore. Unless we stop them, we'll never gain a foothold.

records.name: Out of Hibernation
records.description: The Llothien grizzlies have voracious appetites, and the cliffwing nest right on the ground. It's too tempting a target for hungry bears.

records.name: Too Many Legs
records.description: The Ruins of Falanaar are a dangerous place, especially for any that are wary of arachnids. Thin out the number of Lurkers there.

records.name: Deep Dark
records.description: Our scouts report a system of natural caverns beneath Black Rook Hold. We should investigate to see if they are as fortified as the castle above.

records.name: The Star Buck
records.description: Usually, the squallhunter drakes prey on the stags of Stormheim, but one stag has turned the tables, slaughtering dragons. Hunt down this beast.

records.name: The Lone Dragon
records.description: Storm drakes normally live in colonies or are tamed by the vrykul, but one lone drake does neither. Instead, it preys on everyone.

records.name: The Holdouts
records.description: Many Moonfall Acolytes are still trapped after the Nightfallen attacked the Moon Guard Stronghold. Send in some aid for those left behind.

records.name: Demonic Influence
records.description: The demons of Faronaar extend their influence deep into Azsuna, corrupting any and all they can. Search, and dispose of any under the Legion's thumb.

records.name: Bad Dreams
records.description: The Nightmare has corrupted the roots of Shaladrassil and many creatures within Val'sharah. Seek out and dispose of the crooked elements.

records.name: Keep Your Guard Up
records.description: It's not just the pathways of Highmountain that are cause for concern. Some of the greatest threats lie in wait for the unwary.

records.name: Elite Strike: The Sentinax
records.description: The Command Center has provided us with time-sensitive intel on the Sentinax. Only your most elite champions and troops will have a fighting chance for this opportunity.

records.name: Elite Strike: Legion Supply Cache
records.description: A cache of Legion supplies has been discovered, due to information received from the Command Center. Only your most elite champions and troops will have a chance to take advantage of this opportunity.

records.name: Elite Strike: Lost Temple
records.description: The Command Center reports a library of ancient scrolls hidden beneath the The Lost Temple. Only your most elite champions and troops will have a chance to take advantage of this opportunity.

records.name: Antorus, the Burning Throne
records.description: Antorus, the Legion's seat of power, is within reach. Before marching on the Burning Throne, send our forces to investigate.

records.name: Antorus, the Burning Throne
records.description: Antorus, the Legion's seat of power, is within reach. Before marching on the Burning Throne, send our forces to investigate.
