records.description: Antorus, the Legion's seat of power, is within reach. Before marching on the Burning Throne, send our forces to investigate.

records.name: Antorus, the Burning Throne
records.description: Antorus, the Legion's seat of power, is within reach. Before marching on the Burning Throne, send our forces to investigate.

records.name: Crystallized Fel
records.description: Nath'raxas Hold contains a cache of fel crystals we could use to power our defenses. Infiltrate the Legion's base and recover them.

records.name: Cull Their Numbers
records.description: The panthara in the Grove of Naroua are too numerous, and threaten the cragscaler population. Thin their numbers.

records.name: Foul Machinations
records.description: The Legion is building a weapon in Nath'raxas Hold. Send our champions to discover what it is, and how to destroy it.

records.name: Justice Has Come
records.description: The Army of the Light requires aid defending the Xenedar's wreckage. Help them hold the line.

records.name: Calamitous Consequences
records.description: Powerful weaponry must be removed from the Xenedar before the Legion finds a way past the Army of the Light.

records.name: Spirit of the Vengeful
records.description: An enraged pit lord is leading a battalion of demons to retake the Annihilan Pits. Set a trap to welcome them home.

records.name: Fate of the Fallen
records.description: Annihilan Fanatics are attempting to recover Aggonar's remains to hasten his reconstruction. Disrupt their efforts.

records.name: Fire At Will
records.description: The Legion is fortifying the Deceiver's Scar with Fel Devastators. Sabotage these cannons before they are operational.

records.name: Legion Jailbreak
records.description: Several Lightforged Battlesuit pilots are trapped behind enemy lines on the Shattered Fields. They must be saved.

records.name: Felbound
records.description: Eredar Soulshapers are creating monstrous ur'zul in the Petrified Forest. They must be stopped.

records.name: Pierce the Heart
records.description: The fighting is fiercest on the Shattered Fields. Turn the battle in our favor.

records.name: Fel Machinery
records.description: The Garothi Obliterator roaming the Argus Wastes poses a severe threat to any troop movements. It must be destroyed.

records.name: Step into the Abyss
records.description: Our champions can hold against an army of Legion in the Black Gorge. Do not allow the Legion access to the pass.

records.name: Scaling the Crags
records.description: There is wealth in the Argus Wastes, and the wyrmtongue know how to find it. Track one of these scavengers to their trove.

records.name: End the Siege
records.description: Siegemaster Voraan is launching a new assault on Darkfall Ridge. Defend the Vindicaar against his attacks.

records.name: No Retreat
records.description: Tereck the Selector is capturing Krokul Wranglers in the Petrified Forest. Put an end to him.

records.name: The Big Guns
records.description: The Legion sends supplies from Nath'raxas Hold through the Black Gorge to the Shattered Fields. Confiscate or destroy their next shipment.

records.name: Dashed Defenses
records.description: Life continues to flourish in the Grove of Naroua. It must be protected from Legion patrols.

records.name: Buried
records.description: The krokul want to recover lost artifacts from the ruins of Darkfall Ridge. Guard against Legion attacks while they work.

records.name: Chaos Theorem
records.description: Kil'jaeden's vessel contains powerful artifacts. Send our champions into the wreckage to recover what they can.

records.name: Their Emancipation
records.description: Shadow-touched Krokul have enslaved their brethren in the Ruins of Oronaar. Liberate them from the maddening whispers of the void.

records.name: Preserving Memory
records.description: Spirits of the distant past relive their final nightmares in Triumvirate's End. Set them to rest.

records.name: Invasive Doubts
records.description: Void begins to encroach on the Circle of the Aspirants. Do not allow the void to control any more of Eredath.

records.name: Make Haste
records.description: The Azurelight Bazaar once contained all manner of ancient treasure. Comb through the wreckage.

records.name: Far from Home
records.description: Reinforce the Shadow's Concourse so the ethereals cannot move freely between the Umbra Hollows and Shadowguard Incursion.

records.name: Foreshadowing
records.description: Legion hunters overrun the Arinor Gardens. Determine their mission, and prevent its conclusion.

records.name: Entreat the Fallen
records.description: Before they turned to fel, the eredar were masters of the arcane. Explore the Praetorium in search of lost magic.

records.name: Evasive Species
records.description: Void aberrations are spilling out of the Umbra Hollows. Cull their numbers before they overrun Eredath.

records.name: Delusional
records.description: The voidscarred of Oronaar Collapse are beyond reaching. End their suffering.

records.name: Encroaching Gloom
records.description: The veil between Eredath and the void is fragile within Isolon. Prevent the shadowguard from exploiting this weakness.

records.name: Coalescing Void
records.description: The waters flowing in the Prophet's Reflection are free of fel and void corruption. Discover how this has come to pass.

records.name: Memories of the Lost
records.description: Vigilants endlessly patrol Azurelight Square. Recover any vigilants that can be purified. Destroy those that cannot.

records.name: Unravelling the Madness
records.description: The shadowguard within the Umbra Hollows must be stopped. Send our champions to halt their rituals.

records.name: Argus Antiquities
records.description: Millennia ago, Azurelight Bazaar was a thriving marketplace. Lost treasures of the eredar may still remain.

records.name: Nether or Not
records.description: Roving voidcallers are increasing the shadow's influence in the Shadowguard Incursion. Destroy them.

records.name: Wretched Echoes
records.description: Power flows through the Conservatory of the Arcane. Augari Wakeners practice their craft in death, and must be purged.

records.name: Dark Premonition
records.description: The Talgathi vessel above Kil'jaeden's Terrace ensures the Legion's control over the area. Find a way to dismantle it.

records.name: Disorderly Conduct
records.description: The knowledge to create more vigilants rests within the Wakener's Enclave. Send your champions to retrieve it.

records.name: Calming the Nether
records.description: Shadowguard Abyss Callers  attempt to summon another void lord through the Umbral Locus. Prevent their ritual from succeeding.

records.name: Fabric of Reality
records.description: Void Harvesters are collecting a tremendous amount of void energy in the Shadowguard Incursion. They must be destroyed!

records.name: Go to Fel
records.description: The Defiled Path leads straight to the Burning Breach. Scout ahead for a path across.

records.name: Return Fire
records.description: Infernals blaze across Keeper's Juncture. Banish them back into the Nether.

records.name: Tech Advantage
records.description: The Legion's explosive munitions are crafted in Felfire Armory. Steal as many as you can.

records.name: The Wait Has Ended
records.description: Venture near the Burning Breach. Measure the Legion's defenses.

records.name: The Legion's Vanguard
records.description: Legion vessels dock at Terminus, taking on soldiers and supplies for their assaults against Azeroth. Bring those vessels down.

records.name: Portal Keepers
records.description: Eredar summoners call massive infernals from the Nether. Disrupt their portals.

records.name: Overwhelming Odds
records.description: Two massive fel cannons are wearing down the Vindicaar's shields. Disable them!

records.name: Prevent Apocalypse
records.description: Admiral Rel'var coordinates Legion movements from Terminus. Destroy him.

records.name: Chink in the Armor
records.description: Wyrmtongue engineers working in Felfire Armory are easily lured by riches. Exploit this weakness.

records.name: Chance Meeting
records.description: Numerous krokul slaves are working Scavenger's Post. Free as many as you can.

records.name: Resist the Tide
records.description: An endless stream of Legion demons parade across the Defiled Path toward our footholds. Resist the Tide.

records.name: Demon Exterminators
records.description: Scores of demon arachnids infest Ven'orn's Lair. Exterminate them.

records.name: Foul Riches
records.description: Many fallen litter the Boneyard. Scour the area for implements of power.

records.name: Woe of the Wyrmtongue
records.description: Scavenger's Post is crawling with wyrmtongue looking for valuable salvage. Beat them to it.

records.name: Reinforce Our Defenses
records.description: We can't allow the demons to circumvent our defenses on Fiend's Run. Reinforce the flanks.

records.name: Entrench Our Position
records.description: Scores of Legion forces threaten to push the Vindicaar out of the Antoran Wastes permanently. Don't allow it.

records.name: Bleed Them Dry
records.description: Legion sorcerers use demon blood in their foul rituals. Relieve them of their supply.

records.name: Heralds of War
records.description: Powerful demon lords form the Vanguard of the Legion assault across Fiend's Run. We must take one down.

records.name: Free the Imprisoned
records.description: Lightforged have been wrapped in webs in Ven'orn's Lair. Free them.

records.name: Augmenting Our Assault
records.description: The enemy is targeting our Lightforged Battlesuits. Protect them from the Legion's shriekers.

records.name: Tools of Defiance
records.description: Krokul armaments were abandoned in the Petrified Forest. Seek them out.

records.name: Armor of the Eredar
records.description: Ancient eredar weapons and armor lay within Eredath. Scour the ruins.

records.name: Consecrated Armaments
records.description: Weapons liberated from the Legion can be melted down and reforged into implements of the Light. Raid the enemy's armories.

records.name: Provisioning Resistance
records.description: Darkfall Ridge was a stable settlement for decades. Tools and provisions can be found if the Legion is removed.

records.name: Instruments of War
records.description: Krokul supply caches litter the Argus Wastes. Track them down.

records.name: Relics of Ascendancy
records.description: The shadowguard imbue their weaponry with the shadow. Understanding their techniques could yield potent defenses.

records.name: Ancestral Arms
records.description: The Seat of the Triumvirate was a site of miracles. Strip the ruined husk of any marvels that remain.

records.name: Sanctified Munitions
records.description: Intercept shipments of raw materials headed for Felfire Armory. Bring it back to the Vindicaar for processing.

records.name: Blessed Protection
records.description: Bring the Light to the Spirit Crucible. Do not allow any more souls to be consumed by the Legion's engines.

records.name: Darkfall Ridge Supplies
records.description: Chieftain Hatuun has requested that you recover supplies hidden in Darkfall Ridge. In return, Krokul Ridgestalkers will help your forces navigate Argus' desolate landscape.

records.name: Nath'raxas Breakout
records.description: The krokul wish to rescue their brethren from Nath'raxas Hold before they are turned by the fel. Should you succeed, the Legion's influence in this region will diminish.

records.name: Inches From Madness
records.description: Alleria has asked you to search the Ruins of Oronaar for any krokul not yet consumed by the Shadow.

records.name: Shadowguard Dispersion
records.description: Wresting Argus from the Legion's control will be for naught if the void prevails. Expel the shadowguard from Eredath.

records.name: Gambit in the Wastes
records.description: High Exarch Turalyon has requested your assistance for an audacious assault against the Legion war machine.

records.name: Assault on Felfire Armory
records.description: The Army of the Light will delay Legion reinforcements while Felfire Armory is destroyed by your forces.

records.name: Power of a Titan
records.description: Lady Heretica saturates the infernals of Nath'raxas Hold with Sargerite, dramatically increasing their destructive potential. Put an end to these rituals.

records.name: Blood of the Destroyer
records.description: The Legion's Pit Lords siphon Primal Sargerite from the Annihilan Pits. Destroy them and collect this Sargerite for our order.

records.name: One Way Trip
records.description: The Portal Keepers beneath Kil'jaeden's Terrace are necessary for the Legion to quickly reinforce Eredath. Send the Portal Keepers back into the Nether.

records.name: Tapping into the Fel
records.description: Fel corrupters in the Arinor Gardens thrum with sargerite. Dismantle them.

records.name: Essence of the Evil One
records.description: Foul experiments breed stronger demons in the Putrid Laboratory. Eliminating the Antoran Soulshapers would halt their progress.

records.name: The Underbelly of the Legion
records.description: The Scavenger's Boneyard lay beneath the Legion's garrisons in the Antoran Wastes. Send your champions to waylay Legion patrols traveling between them.

records.name: A Dying World
records.description: There are remote regions of the Argus Wastes with little Legion presence. Scout the Wastes for any resources untouched by fel corruption.

records.name: Secret Tunnel
records.description: When Kil'jaeden's ship crashed into Argus, it uncovered a cave network rich with minerals. We have a day to explore nine caverns before the Legion arrives.

records.name: Meteor Mining
records.description: Many fragments of Argus floating near Eredath appear untouched by fel corruption. Send your champions to investigate.`

records.name: Guiding Whispers
records.description: Voidscarred Krokul hoard Argunite in the Ruins of Oranaar for some dark purpose. Uncover their troves.

records.name: Sully the Circle
records.description: A great summoning circle calls demons from  the Twisting Nether back to Argus. Dismantle the circle; slow the Legion's reinforcements.

records.name: The Spirit Crucible
records.description: A vortex of power envelops the Spirit Crucible. Lead an incursion against the Eredar Soulflayers tapping into that energy.

records.name: Feed the Furnaces
records.description: Lightforged blacksmiths are willing to outfit our champions. Retrieve the materials necessary for their work.

records.name: Abandoned Armory
records.description: Alleria has revealed a forgotten Eredar armory. We should send our champions to investigate.

records.name: Scour the Surface
records.description: Our champions must be adequately armed to assist Hatuun. Order them to search Krokuun for suitable equipment.

records.name: Disruption
records.description: A diversion on the western side of Arathi will provide cover for our troop landing to the east.

records.name: 8.0 - Test of Shadow
records.description: This is only a test. If this had been an actual mission, you would have been told what to do, and where to go.

records.name: Bilgewater Sabotage
records.description: Gallywix's Pride is situated atop Bilgewater Harbor. While the monstrous cannon exists, any assault against Orgrimmar will be impossible. Sabotage the great gun.

records.name: Strike on Drustvar
records.description: Scouts have located a high value Horde target in Drustvar. Eliminate them.

records.name: Hold Until Relieved
records.description: That bridge is a main conduit for Hode Supplies. Disrupting the flow of those supplies is critical to our war effort. Reinforcements are on thier way to relieve you. HOLD THAT POSITION!

records.name: Siege of Astranaar
records.description: The Horde commander responsible for the fall of Silverwind Refuge marches against Astranaar. Show him the Alliance will not give up Ashenvale so easily.

records.name: Test
records.description: A diversion on the western side of Arathi will provide cover for our troop landing to the east.

records.name: The Shadow War
records.description: Our communications to Stormwind are being disrupted by Horde forces in the area.  Send Falstad to clear out any resistance and open communication with the war back home.

records.name: The Shadow War
records.description: Our communications to Orgrimmar are being disrupted by Alliance forces in the area.  Send Valtrois to clear out any resistance and open communication with the war back home.

records.name: At a Crossroads
records.description: A large Alliance army advances on the Crossroads, attempting to cut off Mulgore and Durotar. Send our strongest warriors to meet them.

records.name: The Wolf's Den
records.description: A group of bandits calling themselves the Sailing Wolves have an outpost in Tiragarde Sound. Send your troops to take it for the Horde!

records.name: Teldrassil Evacuation
records.description: A Horde army marches north to Lor'danel; Blood Guard Rockrain at the fore. Send our forces to stall his aggression, so the evacuation of Teldrassil can continue.

records.name: Lordamere Lake
records.description: Forsaken forces under Deathstalker Hayward have captured Fenris Keep. Annihilate the undead to secure Lordamere Lake.

records.name: Undead Rising
records.description: Untold numbers of undead are raised in The Sludge Fields and marched against Gilneas. Send an assault to crush Warden Stillwater's seat of power.

records.name: Our Fort Was a Triumph
records.description: Command wishes to reestablish Fort Triumph. Muster your armies, and send them against Desolation Hold.

records.name: At a Crossroads
records.description: Control over the Crossroads would disrupt Horde troop movements throughout Kalimdor. You must capture it for the Alliance.

records.name: Ashenvale Pass
records.description: Maestra's Post controls the pass between Ashenvale and Darkshore. Orux Thrice-Damned is leading an attack to take control of the region. Take him down.

records.name: Shadowfang Plague
records.description: The undead have holed themselves up in Shadowfang Keep, and are developing a new bio-weapon to unleash against Gilneas. Eliminate their chief plaguebringer.

records.name: Alterac Scouting
records.description: Our intel suggests the Horde have fled into the ruins of Alterac. Send scouts to determine their numbers and fortifications.

records.name: Razor Hill Supplies
records.description: Supplies passing between Orgrimmar and the Echo Isles must pass through Razor Hill. Set fire to their storehouses.

records.name: Lingering in Theramore
records.description: Scout the ruins of Theramore Isle to assess its viability as a base. Beware the lingering effects of the mana bomb used in its destruction.

records.name: Shreds of Warsong
records.description: Warsong Lumber Camp supplies the Horde war machine with lumber. Commandeer a Shredder to wreak havoc on their supply lines.

records.name: Out of Our Depth
records.description: Zoram'gar Outpost is the Horde's only port near Azuremyst Isle. Plant depth charges in the surrounding waters to prevent a naval assault.

records.name: Damming Them All
records.description: Darrowmere River stretches from the Plaguelands to Baradin Bay. Our combat engineers should establish dams to deprive the Horde freedom of movement.

records.name: Destroying the Keep
records.description: Horde forces out of Tarren Mill are attempting to rebuild Durnholde Keep. Reset their progress by laying explosives.

records.name: Salvaging Tiragarde
records.description: A great deal of salvage can be found within the remnants of Tiragarde Keep and along the Scuttle Coast. Recover what you can.

records.name: The Defense of Northwatch Hold
records.description: Rageroar Battleships shell Northwatch Hold once again. Turn our cannons against them to remove the blockade.

records.name: Barrens at War
records.description: Bael Modan is being threatened by a tauren warband from the north. Stand strong with our dwarven allies.

records.name: Great Gate of Mulgore
records.description: Tauren warbraves are on the move from Thunder Bluff to the Barrens. Hold them at the Great Gate of Mulgore.

records.name: Deeps Scouting
records.description: The Horde is showing a renewed interest in Blackfathom Deeps. Send our scouts to investigate what they have discovered, and claim it for the Alliance.

records.name: Darkshore Drilling
records.description: Following the burning of Teldrassil, the Horde are entrenching themselves in northern Darkshore. Eliminate their chief engineer to halt progress.

records.name: Stardust Spire Counterattack
records.description: Sergeant Dontrag leads a Horde assault against Stardust Spire. Eliminating him could sow chaos in the enemy's battle plan. See it done.

records.name: Dalaran Ritual
records.description: The Forsaken mage, Derek the Undying, conducts an arcane ritual in the Dalaran Crater, at the convergence of multiple powerful ley-lines. Put an end to it.

records.name: Dancing with the Dark Rangers
records.description: The dark rangers of Undercity conduct a guerilla war from the abandoned town of Strahnbrad. Send our agents to root them out.

records.name: Azerite Weaponry
records.description: The Horde constructs doomsday weapons using Azerite in Orgrimmar. We must discover what they are building before it is too late.

records.name: Steamwheedle Alliance
records.description: Ratchet plays at neutrality during peace, but serves the Horde in war. Discover the intentions of the Steamwheedle Cartel.

records.name: Ancient Defenses
records.description: The ancient of war, Big Baobob, requires assistance rebuilding the defenses around the Shrine of Aessina. Send the necessary resources.

records.name: Posting Reinforcements
records.description: Splintertree Post has withstood siege by the Sentinel army for too long. Send reinforcements to demolish the Horde base camp.

records.name: Exorcising Dun Garok
records.description: The dwarven ghosts of Dun Garok have been mastered by the Forsaken. They send our own fallen comrades against us. Purge the fortress of Horde and spirit alike.

records.name: Recapture Silverwind Refuge
records.description: Sentinels from Stardust Spire will soon launch an assault to retake Silverwind Refuge from the Horde. Send our finest to bolster their charge.

records.name: Hillsbrad Mine
records.description: A Horde garrison controls Azurelode Mine in southwest Hillsbrad. Send a strike force to seize control of this strategic resource.

records.name: Silverpine Reinforcements
records.description: Horde reinforcements from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest are marching toward Tirisfal under High Executor Hadrec. Halt their advance.

records.name: Echo Isles Navy
records.description: Much of the Horde's naval power is docked in the Echo Isles. Infiltrate the troll capital, and set fire to their ships.

records.name: Deep Elem Mine
records.description: The Deep Elem Mine could be a valuable resource in the war against the Horde in Lordaeron. Set explosives to clear the rubble blocking the mine's entrance.

records.name: Southshore Sabotage
records.description: The blight infecting Southshore is being weaponized by the Horde's apothecaries. Blow their experiments up in their faces.

records.name: Return to Auberdine
records.description: Goblin salvagers have a new Azerite-powered shredder model dismanting the ruins of Auberdine. Steal or sabotage their tech.

records.name: Investigate Wailing Caverns
records.description: Powerful magic seeps through the Wailing Caverns, transforming the Barrens. Devise a way to leverage that magic for the Alliance.

records.name: Barren Supplies
records.description: Lay siege to Hunter's Hill. If we capture it, we will control passage between the Barrens and Stonetalon Mountains.

records.name: Shreds of Warsong
records.description: The dryad Illiyana has rallied her sisters in Forest Song. Their nature magic is destroying our Shredders. Eliminate them all.

records.name: Ashenvale Pass
records.description: Maestra's Post controls the pass between Ashenvale and Darkshore. Moon Priestess Maestra's vigil must end. Bring her down.

records.name: Gilnean Assault
records.description: Scouts report a Gilnean army under Darius Crowley marches against Hillsbrad. Set upon his forces at the Sludge Fields, where our power is greatest.

records.name: Wall Them Off
records.description: An Alliance host marches from Stromgarde towards the ruins of Durnholde keep, to secure Thoradin's wall. Send our mightest warriors to meet them.

records.name: Tiragarde Ruins
records.description: The Alliance brazenly attempts to rebuild Tiragarde Keep. Bring our full might down upon them and scour the ruins from Horde lands.

records.name: [ph]
records.description: [ph]

records.name: Siege of Astranaar
records.description: Thenysil commands the remaining Sentinels in Ashenvale. Infiltrate Astranaar and take her down before they muster their strength.

records.name: Teldrassil Evacuation
records.description: Dentaria Silverglade in Lor'danel oversees the evacuation of the Teldrassian survivors to Azuremyst. Slaying her will sow chaos in their ranks.

records.name: Lordamere Lake
records.description: The Bloodfang Pack controls Fenris Isle. Create a distraction along the Misty Shore to lure them out of position, allowing Horde refugees to escape Tirisfal across the water.

records.name: Mounted Resistance
records.description: Wildhammer Gryphon Riders patrol Darrowmere River, preventing troop movements. Under the cover of darkness, infiltrate their roost and slay their mounts.

records.name: Defending Durotar
records.description: We have reports of Alliance ships off the Scuttle Coast. Investigate their numbers and their intentions.

records.name: Bilgewater Sabotage
records.description: Alliance forces sabotaged Gallywix's Pride, the great gun above Bilgewater Harbor. See it repaired to secure Bladefist Bay.

records.name: Out of your Depth
records.description: The Zoram'gar Docks will be vital for any assault against Azuremyst Isle. Plant depth charges to prevent any naval assault by the Alliance.

records.name: Shadowfang Plague
records.description: Plaguebringer Harris has developed a new bio-weapon. Unleash his plague on the 7th legion forces surrounding Shadowfang Keep.

records.name: Rebuilding Alterac
records.description: The ruins of Alterac could be repaired to serve as a defensible base of operations for the Horde in Lordaeron. Send forces to see the work done.

records.name: Blockade of Northwatch
records.description: Northwatch Hold relies on superior firepower to keep our forces at bay. Install goblin Azerite cannons on the northern shore of the Great Divide.

records.name: Salvaging the Battlescar
records.description: There is usable salvage within the battlescar of the southern barrens. Recover what you can. Avoid the dwarves of Bael Modan.

records.name: Barrens at War
records.description: The Alliance is using Bael Modan as a staging point against Mulgore. Purge their armies from the Barrens.

records.name: Great Gate of Mulgore
records.description: Taurajo has lain in ruins long enough. March our warriors against the Alliance soldiers who siege the Great Gate. Punish the Alliance looters.

records.name: Investigate Stardust Spire
records.description: Alliance soldiers continue pouring into Ashenvale, reinforcing their holdings. Investigate Stardust Spire for any weaknesses.

records.name: Return to Auberdine
records.description: New Azerite-powered shredders devised by our goblin allies are salvaging the ruins of Auberdine. Prevent any Alliance spies from gathering information.

records.name: Deeps Scouting
records.description: The Alliance is showing a renewed interest in Blackfathom Deeps. Send our scouts to investigate what they have found there.

records.name: Dancing with Dark Rangers
records.description: An army of Alliance soldiers from the Plaguelands marches towards Hillsbrad. Attack from the shadows to slow their progress.

records.name: Dalaran Ritual
records.description: A human mage, High Sorceror Andromath, conducts an arcane ritual in the Dalaran Crater, at the convergence of multiple powerful ley-lines. Put an end to it.

records.name: Orgrimmar Armory
records.description: The vengeful night elves have recalled their forces stationed throughout Kalimdor, to begin a campaign against Orgrimmar. Track their movements across the continent.

records.name: Steamwheedle Alliance
records.description: The Steamwheedle Cartel will not openly declare for the Horde, but provides a vital stream of supplies. Prevent the Alliance from discovering these smuggling operations.

records.name: Darkshore Drilling
records.description: Night elves streaming out of Darnassus pose a threat to Shatterspear Vale. Construct defenses in the nearby war camp to protect our troll allies.

records.name: Exorcising Dun Garok
records.description: The dwarves of Ironforge marshal their forces to retake Dun Garok. Drive them back through Thoradin's Wall.

records.name: Posting Reinforcements
records.description: The kal'dorei siege our outposts across Ashenvale. Splintertree Post must not be allowed to fall. Send reinforcements.

records.name: Recapture Silverwind Refuge
records.description: Huntress Jalin leads her Sentinels against Silverwind Refuge, attempting to retake it for the Alliance. Throw them back.

records.name: Azurelode Mine
records.description: Our garrison in control of the Azurelode Mine has come under assault. We must not lose control of this vital source of ore.

records.name: Silverpine Reinforcements
records.description: With the fall of Lordaeron, the Alliance has set its sights on Silverpine Forest. Defend the Sepulcher against encroaching forces.

records.name: Echo Isles Navy
records.description: Alliance raids against the Echo Isles are damaging our ability to supply the Eastern Kingdoms warfront. Construct greater defenses around our largest port.

records.name: Deep Elem Mine
records.description: Gnomish explosives line the walls of Deep Elem Mine. They must be cleared out so mining operations can continue.

records.name: Southshore Sabotage
records.description: A cadre of paladins under Raleigh the Devout attempts to purify the ruins of Southshore. Provoke the blighted creatures there to disrupt his efforts.

records.name: Ancient Defenses
records.description: An ancient of war allied with the Sentinels stands vigil over the Shrine of Aessina. Burn it to the ground.

records.name: Investigate Wailing Caverns
records.description: Powerful magic seeps through the Wailing Caverns, transforming the Barrens. Devise a way to leverage that magic for the Horde.

records.name: Barren Supplies
records.description: The Alliance cannot hold Honor's Stand without supplies. Lay siege and starve them out.

records.name: Wolves For The Den
records.description: A pack of dire wolves have been stalking Wolf's Den. Rexxar should be able to track and tame the beasts for the outpost.

records.name: Test Mission
records.description: Test Mission

records.name: Lingering in Theramore
records.description: Scout the ruins of Theramore Isle to assess its viability as a base. Beware the lingering effects of the mana bomb used in its destruction.

records.name: Stonefist Watch
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost on Vigil Hill, but it is currently guarded by the local militia. Dispatch a war party to clear them out!

records.name: Swiftwind Post
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost in Drustvar, but it is currently infested with wicker beasts. Dispatch a war party to clear the area!

records.name: Mudfisher Cove
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost in Drustvar. Dispatch a war party to secure the area.

records.name: Windfall Cavern
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost on Windwhisper Summit, but the cave is home to a man-eating grizzly. Dispatch a hunting party to slay the beast!

records.name: Hillcrest Pasture
records.description: Our scouts have found an ideal location for an outpost in Stormsong Valley, but it is currently occupied by the enemy. Dispatch a war party to claim Hillcrest Pasture for the Horde!
